title: Tryqo's Texture pack
description: This Texture pack is looking for a vanilla style pack, it holds what most people want in a texture pack.
body:
This texture pack includes:

-Short Swords

-Bow & Crossbow charging

-Arabic Numerals (ex: Protection IV -> Protection 4)

-Bedwars & bridge overlay (Better wool, better Terracotta)

-No block break particles

-Low Shield, Low fire, Small totem, Small totem pop, No fire particles

-Visible powdered snow, and Tripwire

-Splash type EXP bottles

-Better Redstone

-Smaller Critical hit particles

-Smaller Potion particles

-No fog (Water, Lava and Powdered Snow)

-Pufferfish mace

-Transparent Crystals

-No Explosion Particles

-Ore Outlines

-Marlowww's Texture pack font

-Clearer Armor

-Transparent UI

If you have any ideas or bugs please contact me on discord : dab04572
